headline: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited: Shareholders meeting
sum: Shareholders meeting — Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about the Notice of NCLT convened meeting of the Equity Shareholders of the Company to be held on Monday, September 7, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. pursuant to the…
detail: Shareholders meeting — Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about the Notice of NCLT convened meeting of the Equity Shareholders of the Company to be held on Monday, September 7, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. pursuant to the order dated July 2, 2026 passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench.
